name: @usehyppo/mcp

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List current normalized public market snapshots from supported market-data providers. This is read-only informational context: it does not access a brokerage account, place an order, or provide personalized investment advice.

tools.name: get_market_snapshot
tools.description: Get one current normalized public market snapshot by canonical id, provider id, or symbol. This is read-only informational context: it does not access a brokerage account, place an order, or provide personalized investment advice.

market.description: Canonical market id, provider id, or symbol

tools.name: get_market_candles
tools.description: Get normalized OHLCV candles for one exact canonical market ID returned by Hyppo market discovery. Use 4h and 1d candles to derive trade levels from price structure instead of a single quote. This is read-only informational context: it does not access a brokerage account, place an order, or provide personalized investment advice.

market.description: Exact canonical market id returned by list_markets or get_market_snapshot

lookbackDays.description: Number of calendar days ending at endTimeMs (or now) to request

endTimeMs.description: Optional UTC epoch milliseconds; defaults to the current time

tools.name: astrology_getAstrologyCatalog
tools.description:
Get financial-astrology taxonomy and evidence notes
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Returns the informational financial-astrology taxonomy and evidence notes. It is research context only and must not be represented as a trading signal or guarantee.
Hyppo API operation: GET /v1/events/astrology/catalog

tools.name: astrology_listAstrologyCategoryEvents
tools.description:
List curated financial-astrology events by category
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Returns one category from the curated informational financial-astrology calendar. Do not present correlations as causal evidence, certainty, or personalized investment advice.
Hyppo API operation: GET /v1/events/astrology/{category}

tools.name: astrology_listAstrologyEvents
tools.description:
List curated financial-astrology calendar events
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Returns a curated informational financial-astrology calendar. Do not present correlations as causal evidence, certainty, or personalized investment advice.
Hyppo API operation: GET /v1/events/astrology

tools.name: auth_getMe
tools.description:
Get the current authenticated user
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Use this to identify the Hyppo account authorized by the current bearer token. It returns only that Hyppo account, does not reveal the user's ChatGPT identity, and makes no changes.
Hyppo API operation: GET /v1/me

tools.name: auth_updateMe
tools.description:
Update current user preferences
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Updates preferences on the currently authorized Hyppo account only. It does not link or change a ChatGPT identity and does not affect any external account.
Hyppo API operation: PATCH /v1/me

tools.name: events_getEventListeners
tools.description:
Get the current user event listener profile
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Returns the authorized Hyppo user's private event-listener preferences. It does not read another user's settings or modify notifications.
Hyppo API operation: GET /v1/events/listeners

tools.name: events_listFomcEvents
tools.description:
List Federal Reserve FOMC events
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Returns the public Federal Reserve FOMC calendar for research context. It does not predict market direction or provide personalized investment advice.
Hyppo API operation: GET /v1/events/fomc

tools.name: events_listMacroEvents
tools.description:
List scheduled macroeconomic release events
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Returns a public macroeconomic release calendar for research context. It does not predict the release outcome or recommend a trade.
Hyppo API operation: GET /v1/events/macro

tools.name: events_listMarketSessionEvents
tools.description:
List market open and close events
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Returns public market-session opening and closing times for calendar context. It does not place orders or guarantee venue availability.
Hyppo API operation: GET /v1/events/market-sessions

tools.name: events_listSeasonalityEvents
tools.description:
List trader seasonality and calendar-effect events
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Returns curated public seasonality and calendar-effect observations. Treat them as informational context, not causal evidence or a guaranteed trading signal.
Hyppo API operation: GET /v1/events/seasonality

tools.name: events_listUserEvents
tools.description:
List events for the current user listeners
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Returns events selected by the authorized Hyppo user's private listener configuration. It does not change the listener profile or any external calendar.
Hyppo API operation: GET /v1/events

tools.name: events_replaceEventListeners
tools.description:
Replace the current user event listener profile
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Replaces the authorized Hyppo user's private event-listener preferences. It changes Hyppo account configuration only and does not alter external calendars or accounts.
Hyppo API operation: POST /v1/events/listeners

tools.name: ideas_acceptIdeaCandidate
tools.description:
Accept an idea candidate into the canonical trade record
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Accepts a private research candidate into the canonical Hyppo Trade record. It remains in the idea phase unless wallet reconciliation independently finds a position; no order is placed and no brokerage or exchange is contacted.
Hyppo API operation: POST /v1/idea-candidates/{candidateId}/accept

tools.name: ideas_createSourceIngestion
tools.description:
Submit a research source for ingestion and idea extraction
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Creates a private asynchronous research-ingestion job and may retrieve the user-supplied source from the internet. It does not publish the source, place an order, or create an executed trade.
Hyppo API operation: POST /v1/sources/ingestions

tools.name: ideas_getSourceIngestion
tools.description:
Get ingestion, extraction, and candidate progress
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Returns processing progress for one research-ingestion job owned by the authorized Hyppo user. It does not restart or change the job.
Hyppo API operation: GET /v1/source-ingestions/{ingestionId}

tools.name: ideas_listIdeaCandidates
tools.description:
List extracted idea candidates for review
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Lists private research candidates awaiting review for the authorized Hyppo user. Candidates are research records, not investment recommendations or executable orders.
Hyppo API operation: GET /v1/idea-candidates

tools.name: ideas_rejectIdeaCandidate
tools.description:
Reject an idea candidate
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Marks a private research candidate as rejected for the authorized Hyppo user. This changes review state only and never cancels or executes a financial order.
Hyppo API operation: POST /v1/idea-candidates/{candidateId}/reject

tools.name: markets_getPolymarketAssetMarkets
tools.description:
Discover active Polymarket markets for an asset
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Retrieves public Polymarket listings related to an asset. It does not place a prediction-market order, connect a wallet, transfer funds, or change any market.
Hyppo API operation: POST /v1/markets/polymarket/assets

tools.name: markets_getPolymarketMacroMarkets
tools.description:
Discover active Polymarket markets for a macro release
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Retrieves public Polymarket listings related to a macroeconomic release. It does not place a prediction-market order, connect a wallet, transfer funds, or change any market.
Hyppo API operation: POST /v1/markets/polymarket/macro

tools.name: trades_addTradeClaim
tools.description:
Add a catalyst, invalidation, or risk claim
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Adds exactly one catalyst, invalidation, or risk claim with optional evidence references and a normalized exact or bounded timeframe. Use this instead of guessing where conditional trade data belongs.
Hyppo API operation: POST /v1/trades/{tradeId}/claims

tools.name: trades_addTradeLeg
tools.description:
Add one instrument leg to a trade
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Adds exactly one structural trade leg. When canonical instrument and market IDs are supplied, Hyppo verifies them against its live market catalogue before saving. Multiple legs make the trade strategy-like without creating a separate strategy resource. This records intent only and never executes an order.
Hyppo API operation: POST /v1/trades/{tradeId}/legs

tools.name: trades_createTrade
tools.description:
Create a minimal trade idea
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Creates the minimal shell for one private trade record and may attach origin or context references. Then use the focused overview, claim, leg, and plan tools to add known data; do not set lifecycle state because Hyppo infers it from wallet-resolved positions.
Hyppo API operation: POST /v1/trades

tools.name: trades_getTrade
tools.description:
Get one trade and its immediate records
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Returns one canonical trade record with research, optional plan, and wallet-resolved positions. Its phase is inferred and cannot be set by this tool.
Hyppo API operation: GET /v1/trades/{tradeId}

tools.name: trades_listTrades
tools.description:
List lightweight trade summaries
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Lists the authorized user's canonical trade records. Filter by instrument, market, or asset before creating a duplicate. Plans remain ideas, and position fields are wallet-resolved records rather than proof supplied by the model.
Hyppo API operation: GET /v1/trades

tools.name: trades_setTradeDisposition
tools.description:
Archive, dismiss, or restore a trade
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Changes only whether the Hyppo trade record is active, archived, or dismissed. It cannot mark the trade open or closed and cannot cancel a real order.
Hyppo API operation: PUT /v1/trades/{tradeId}/disposition

tools.name: trades_setTradeOverview
tools.description:
Set trade thesis, conviction, or normalized horizon
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Sets narrative overview fields, numeric conviction from 0 to 100, and an exact or bounded UTC horizon on one trade. Use referenced resources to support a normalized horizon. It cannot set lifecycle phase.
Hyppo API operation: PATCH /v1/trades/{tradeId}/overview

tools.name: trades_setTradePlan
tools.description:
Set the plan for one trade leg
MCP profile: primary. Preferred for normal model workflows.
Model guidance: Sets the executable plan for one existing trade leg with a resolved instrument and market, including entry, stop, targets, sizing, expiry, and provenance for derived values. This remains an idea until wallet-resolved positions exist.
Hyppo API operation: PUT /v1/trades/{tradeId}/legs/{legId}/plan

tools.name: hyppo_auth_status
tools.description: Check whether this local MCP server has a usable Hyppo session. Never returns credentials.

tools.name: hyppo_login
tools.description: Open the Hyppo login page in the user’s browser and wait for explicit sign-in. Stores the session locally and never returns credentials.

tools.name: hyppo_logout
tools.description: Delete the local Hyppo session used by this MCP server. Does not delete the Hyppo account.

instructions: Use Hyppo for informational market context and the authenticated user's private Hyppo records. For a trade request, resolve the exact canonical market with list_markets, fetch its current snapshot plus relevant 4h and 1d candles, then call trades_listTrades with the instrument, market, or asset before creating a duplicate. Use trades_createTrade for both early ideas and detailed plans: a plan remains an idea, and multiple legs make it a strategy without a separate resource. Never set or claim lifecycle state. Hyppo infers idea, open, or closed only from wallet-resolved positions. The OAuth bearer token identifies the authorized Hyppo user; never infer identity from the ChatGPT account or conversation. Hyppo cannot access a brokerage or exchange, submit or cancel orders, transfer assets, or execute trades. Confirm intent before writes and never represent Hyppo output as personalized investment advice, a guarantee, or proof of execution.
